trigger: L=n*d_min, so every live variable has incidence degree exactly d_min

definitions.t_y: retained incidence of nonpivot variable y; in the regular case this is exactly its omission count among the d pivot parents
definitions.Omax_R0: max sum_y f_p_q(t_y) subject to 0<=t_y<=c and sum_y t_y=R0
definitions.h: number of those D resolvent clauses already present among the c retained clauses
definitions.K: c+D-h distinct clauses in the global raw set

statement: At a unit-free canonical state with L=n*d_min, fix selected-pivot split p+q=d. For each feasible retained literal mass 2c<=R0<=cr, total cross-pair support mass is at least Smin(R0)=r*pq-Omax(R0). If D distinct non-tautological resolvents exist, representatives for them have total width at least max(0,Smin(R0)-(pq-D)r). If h of those resolvents coincide with retained clauses, global raw literal mass is at least R0+max(0,Smin-(pq-D)r)-h*r, while K=c+D-h distinct raw clauses can have total width at most Wmax_r(K). Therefore only triples (R0,D,h) satisfying R0+max(0,Smin-(pq-D)r)-h*r<=Wmax_r(K) and K<=3^r are feasible. The exact raw resource ceiling is the maximum of 1+K+Wmax_r(K) over these feasible integer triples.
proof: L=n*d_min and every variable degree is at least d_min; since degree sum is L, every live variable has degree exactly d_min.

For a nonpivot variable y with retained incidence t_y, its pivot-parent incidence is d-t_y because its total degree is d. Among exactly d pivot-parent clauses it is therefore omitted exactly t_y times. Splitting those omissions as a_y on the p side and b_y on the q side gives a_y+b_y=t_y and at most f_p_q(t_y)=a_y*b_y omitted cross pairs.
Summing over all r variables, at most Omax(R0) pair-variable incidences are omitted, so pair-support mass is at least Smin(R0)=r*pq-Omax(R0).

From pq parent pairs remove all tautological pairs and all but one representative of each duplicate resolvent. Exactly D representative pairs remain. Each removed pair has support at most r, so the D representatives have total support, hence resolvent width, at least max(0,Smin-(pq-D)r).

The c retained clauses have literal mass R0. If h distinct resolvents equal retained clauses, adding retained and resolvent width double-counts at most h*r literals. Thus global raw literal mass is at least R0+resolvent_width_lower-h*r.

The raw container is one set of K=c+D-h distinct signed clauses over r variables. Its literal mass is at most Wmax_r(K), and K<=3^r. Therefore every actual state induces a feasible integer triple satisfying the stated inequality.

Taking the maximum 1+K+Wmax_r(K) over all feasible R0,D,h yields an exact upper bound on engine raw_units for this regular state. The finite optimization is deterministic and polynomial in the explicit state parameters.
